description: This file defines the TextGrid class, which provides functionality to render a two-dimensional matrix as a formatted text grid, supporting CLI and HTML display modes.

classes.name: TextGrid
classes.description: A helper class for rendering a matrix as a formatted text grid in CLI or HTML.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matrix and display mode, setting up internal structures.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the matrix as a formatted string suitable for CLI or HTML display.

methods.name: renderRows
methods.description: Renders each row of the matrix as part of the grid display.

methods.name: renderCells
methods.description: Renders individual cells for a row with proper padding.

methods.name: renderColumnHeader
methods.description: Renders the header row with column references.

methods.name: renderFooter
methods.description: Renders the footer line of the grid.

methods.name: getColumnWidths
methods.description: Calculates the width of each column based on cell contents.

methods.name: getColumnWidth
methods.description: Determines the width of a single column based on its data.
